posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get a verified integration on Make (DR 90). You get a dedicated page with a dofollow link to your website.

Here is how:

1. Sign up for a regular https://www.make.com/ account. The free plan is enough to build and test.

2. Open Custom Apps and create an app: a connection that asks for the API key, plus one module per main action like create, list and delete (ask Claude to build it for you from your OpenAPI file).

3. Run every module in a real scenario. Make wants a link to a successful run for each module, plus one scenario that shows an API error.

4. Make all modules visible, fill in the review form with those scenario links and your docs URL, and click Request review.

A few notes:

Make users can add your app to their scenarios straight from the module picker.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 make.com 注册免费账号，创建 Custom App（API key 连接 + 各主要 action 的 module），在真实 scenario 运行每个 module 并提供成功运行链接和错误场景后提交 review，得到 DR90 dofollow 外链页面。

posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to publish your extension on Firefox Add-ons. It gets its own page on Mozilla's domain (DR 96).

If you already have a Chrome extension, you're almost done. Firefox runs the same code with two small additions.

Here is how:

1. Build a small extension that does one thing from your SaaS, right in the browser. I made a small post scheduler that works with an API key (ask Claude to do it for you).

2. Add a Firefox block to your manifest: an extension ID and the data your extension collects. Firefox requires both.

3. Create a free developer account on addons.mozilla .org and upload the zip.

4. If your code is bundled, upload the source code too, with build steps so the reviewer can rebuild it.

A few notes:

Keep it simple and related to your website. One clear job is enough.

AI loves to cite Firefox Add-ons pages, and they rank very high on Google.
posts.author: Taras
posts.notes: 在 addons.mozilla.org 创建免费开发者账号，构建一个简单的浏览器扩展（做一件 SaaS 相关的事），在 manifest 添加 Firefox 块（extension ID 和数据收集），上传 zip（如需附源码和构建步骤），得到 Mozilla 域名上的 DR96 页面和 dofollow 外链。

posts.content:
一条 DR 94 的 dofollow 外链，免费，加一个站只要几分钟。

这是我目前拿到的 DR 最高的有效外链，来自 Weebly。

做法：注册一个免费的 Weebly 站，做成作品集页，把自己的站一个个挂上去。

几个操作细节：

1️⃣ 别用它的拖拽编辑器排版

我把整页写成一段 HTML，贴进"设置 → SEO → 页脚代码"，再加一行 CSS 把默认的内容区藏起来。

想怎么排就怎么排，代码让 AI 写。

2️⃣ 每个站做成一张卡片

一张截图、一句话介绍、一个链接，截图上传到主题文件里引用。

以后有新站，复制一张卡片改改就行。

3️⃣ 发布后自己查一遍

打开网页源码，搜你的域名。

链接上没有 nofollow，页面也没有 noindex，才算数。

我今天又查了一遍，9 条链接都还在。

最后说句实在话：

DR 94 是 https://t.co/aqUcrCXaBQ 整个域名的分数。你的页面在子域名上，本身没什么外链，传过去的权重远没有 94 那么多。

带来的访客，我这边到现在是 0。

它的价值是：新站上线当天，几分钟就能有一条干净的 dofollow 外链。

收藏一下 📌 下个新站上线那天顺手加上。

posts.notes: 在 Weebly 注册免费站点做成作品集页，用 HTML 贴到页脚代码并隐藏默认内容区，做成卡片挂自己网站链接，得到 DR94 dofollow 外链（子域名权重有限，自己验证 9 条仍在、访客 0）。

posts.content:
Another great visibility hack for your SaaS is to get listed on the Notion Marketplace (DR 90). You get a dedicated page and a dofollow link.

Shoutout to @aarondelasy for sharing it

Here is how:

1. Find a simple use case that sends data from your SaaS into Notion, like new leads or reports landing as rows in a Notion database (ask Claude to build it for you).

2. Create a public connection in Notion's developer settings. Set the installation scope to "Any workspace", you can't change it later.

3. On the connection page, click Publish to Marketplace and fill in the name, description, category, logo and a few screenshots.

4. Submit it. Notion replies by email in 5 to 10 business days.

A few notes:

Your page goes live at notion .com/connections/<your-name>, with a dofollow link to your website.

Your customers can also connect your SaaS to their Notion workspace in a few clicks, so it's great for them as well.

posts.notes: 在 Notion Marketplace 创建一个公共集成（将 SaaS 数据发送到 Notion 数据库），在开发者设置发布到 marketplace（scope 设为 Any workspace），填写信息提交，得到 DR90 dofollow 外链页面（审核 5-10 个工作日）。
